basis_note: All figures Solo basis including the Offshore Banking Unit, from National Bank's own 'Five Years Financial Summary'. FY2025-sourced figures were converted from crore to million (x10). FY2011-FY2014 come from the FY2015 report (earlier reports are not in the archive) and FY2021-FY2023 from the FY2024 report (those years' own PDFs are image-only). NBL's table reports no provision figures, so provision coverage is unavailable for every year. UPDATE 2026-08-27: six Q1-Q3 interim periods (2024_Q1 through 2025_Q3) were appended below the original Q4-only annual periods, covering the quarters immediately around National Bank's insolvency crossing (equity turned negative during 2025_Q2). These interim entries use a lighter-weight subset of the schema than the annual periods above (several Basel/NPL/provision fields are null because NBL's interim filings do not disclose them) -- see each period's own data_completeness_note. ROE is explicitly nulled for 2025_Q2 and 2025_Q3 per the negative-equity-breaks-ROE rule, since equity is negative in both. Q3-2022, Q3-2023, and FY2011-2014/2026 quarters were not added here even though some now exist in quarterly/*.json, to keep this file focused on the crossing-relevant window; the full set of newly-sourced quarters is in quarterly/*.json and documented in sources.json.

periods.eps_note: As reported for this period (discrete Q1, cumulative H1 for Q2, cumulative 9M for Q3) -- not annualized.
periods.yoy_growth_pct_note: profit_after_tax and classified_loans YoY growth intentionally left null: NBL's PAT has been a loss (often from a loss base) for multiple consecutive quarters, which is exactly the YoY-growth-from-negative-base distortion this dataset's standing rules warn about (see the GIB precedent); classified_loans/NPL ratio is not disclosed in the interim filings at all, only in the annual summary table. total_equity growth is nulled for any quarter where either the current or prior-year value is <= 0, for the same reason.
periods.data_completeness_note: npl_ratio_pct, provision_coverage_pct, car_pct, tier1_ratio_pct, cost_income_ratio_pct and price_to_book are null because NBL's interim (Q1/Q2/Q3) financial statements do not disclose Basel capital ratios, NPL percentages, or provision detail the way the annual report's summary table does, and no per-quarter market share price was sourced in this pass. See bank_financials/NBL/quarterly/<year>_<quarter>.json for the full sourced balance-sheet and income-statement detail behind every figure here.
